## 操作环境
仅编写和评审具体设计工件，不执行部署、镜像构建、推送或Git历史变更。场景数据为题目给定，示例摘要/域名不能当作可信生产材料。

## 给定材料
已批准摘要/配置对、同标签不同摘要、配置漂移、证明subject不匹配及验证器不可用等给定证据；均为教学材料非可信实时审批。

## 操作任务
交付精确审批绑定清单、制品仓库/身份隔离和最终目标校验合同、给定证据的拒绝/审计矩阵、合法替代和回退规则。只审材料并设计安全验证；不构造伪造证明、不替换镜像、不执行发布。

## 产物
- approved-release-register.yaml
- release-gate-contract.yaml
- given-evidence-decisions.csv
- decision-and-safe-validation.md

非作者按给定输入、逐文件完整参考、合法替代、两种实质错解和原题范围人工语义评阅；不能以标题/关键词或YAML语法正确自动判通过。平台检查仅验证导入、题型、公共字段和seed幂等。设计中的执行/测量均为待执行条件，不伪造原生命令、运行结果或生产事故。

## decision-and-safe-validation.md
# Approval-to-effective-artifact design review — no replacement or proof creation performed
Treat approval as a binding to exact artifact digest and versioned configuration/rendered hash, reviewed source and evidence subject, not a tag or UI checkbox. The training register contains scenario identifiers only; it is not authentic approval or signature proof. Live release remains held until the existing trusted systems provide authentic records. Require registry immutability/retention and separated build-write, approve and deploy-read capabilities; preserve existing default identity and original access behavior. Any permission gap needs a separately scoped proposal, not administrator expansion.

Re-read the actual resolved registry/workload digest at the final release boundary and match the approved pair. Verify signatures using the existing approved trust roots and builder identity; verify provenance subject and reviewed source. Signature validity alone is insufficient when its subject is another artifact. A post-approval config change also requires fresh approval. Verification unavailable or evidence expired/unknown fails closed; audit exact observed and approved identifiers without secret content.

The supplied decision matrix is a document/evidence review exercise. It does not forge signatures, replace images, modify registries, execute exploits or claim native admission behavior was tested. A future authorized test may safely use pre-existing trusted positive/negative evidence fixtures in a bounded isolated gate; record the actual refusal result/reason and ensure no target mutation. Do not replay malicious proof creation or image replacement to manufacture evidence in this session.

Rollback selects a previously approved exact artifact/config pair and additionally checks current data compatibility, dependency support and secret references. Revalidate actual effective digest and business recovery; a valid old approval does not prove a current schema is compatible. On mismatch stop promotion, retain audit evidence and use approved recovery rather than deleting shared artifacts or bypassing verification. No cloud, registry or target resources were created here.

## execution-and-recovery.md
# Applied ownership design — no synchronization executed
Use canonical cluster/scope/kind/namespace/name identity and exactly one trusted manager per row. Platform manages cluster objects and shared namespace lifecycle; checkout owns only its specified application objects; data owner retains the PVC. Namespace location alone does not grant application ownership of everything inside it. Repository and supported GitOps project/RBAC restrictions must enforce the boundaries; tracking metadata is necessary audit input, not independent authority to seize an object.

Before sync/prune read actual object identities, tracking metadata, ownership register and rendered diff. Two applications claiming the same Deployment block both conflicting writes until owners resolve a reviewed transfer. Do not solve ownership collisions by deleting/recreating the object or changing default credentials. A supported transfer requires old manager stop managing that object without deleting it, recorded new-owner acceptance, preservation of object/data identity and a no-unrelated-change diff.

An unreviewed empty source directory is a deletion incident, not a command to erase the namespace. Stop affected prune, retain current state and source evidence, require a reviewed exact delete list. PVC/data objects remain retained until explicit data-owner release and recovery evidence; ordinary application deletion cannot override that. Platform upgrade is independently staged for API/CRD/controller compatibility and existing application tracking; app success cannot authorize cluster scope.

Validation remains a future bounded, authorized operation. Check rejected duplicate ownership, empty-directory holds, PVC retention, scoped legitimate removal, and platform-upgrade compatibility. Record raw existing-tool outputs and preservation of unrelated resources/default access. On regression restore reviewed source/ownership mapping and supported reconciliation state, not shared Git resets or blind namespace deletion. Design creates no resources; cleanup only private review files.

# Applied ownership design — no synchronization executed
Use canonical cluster/scope/kind/namespace/name identity and exactly one trusted manager per row. Platform manages cluster objects and shared namespace lifecycle; checkout owns only its specified application objects; data owner retains the PVC. Namespace location alone does not grant application ownership of everything inside it. Repository and supported GitOps project/RBAC restrictions must enforce the boundaries; tracking metadata is necessary audit input, not independent authority to seize an object.

Before sync/prune read actual object identities, tracking metadata, ownership register and rendered diff. Two applications claiming the same Deployment block both conflicting writes until owners resolve a reviewed transfer. Do not solve ownership collisions by deleting/recreating the object or changing default credentials. A supported transfer requires old manager stop managing that object without deleting it, recorded new-owner acceptance, preservation of object/data identity and a no-unrelated-change diff.

An unreviewed empty source directory is a deletion incident, not a command to erase the namespace. Stop affected prune, retain current state and source evidence, require a reviewed exact delete list. PVC/data objects remain retained until explicit data-owner release and recovery evidence; ordinary application deletion cannot override that. Platform upgrade is independently staged for API/CRD/controller compatibility and existing application tracking; app success cannot authorize cluster scope.

Validation remains a future bounded, authorized operation. Check rejected duplicate ownership, empty-directory holds, PVC retention, scoped legitimate removal, and platform-upgrade compatibility. ## recovery-runbook.md
# End-to-end recovery design review — no recovery/test release executed
Assume an existing approved isolated recovery target and authentic backup set can be requested; none has been restored by this design. First validate backup timestamps/digests and compatibility of controller config, plugin/version state, secret decryption references and artifact index. A controller login screen proves only UI reachability. Restored ciphertext without authorized usable decryption capability is not credential recovery; never print keys/secrets into evidence.

Reconnect only the approved limited agent identity, verify controller/agent execution direction and normal task scope, then verify content-addressed artifact lookup. Reconcile Q/R/C job states against actual external effect ledger before resuming work. R-001 is explicitly unknown: hold and inspect actual target/partial side effects; C-001 must not be rerun. Queue recovery cannot silently drop or duplicate release events.

The future separately authorized trusted test release must traverse restored source/parameters, test gate, approved artifact/config binding, approval and existing isolated target update, ending at actual effective digest/config and business health. This session forbids deployment, so it supplies only the complete test/acceptance contract and does not run this step or infer its success from static checks. If a required resource/permission/material is absent, keep recovery unaccepted with that exact gap.

Record approval/start/end times, restored event horizon and business observations with source evidence. RTO target 30 minutes and RPO target 15 minutes are scenario goals; actual fields remain blank until measured. Include restore/validation phases consistently and record approval/discovery delays separately. A fast login cannot set restored_business_at. Data loss must be measured independently of uptime.

On failed recovery stop job resumption, preserve isolated evidence and effect ledger, revert only this rehearsal's own controller/config state through the approved snapshots, and reconcile partial effects before another attempt. Do not reset shared service state or change default credentials to make an agent connect. Delete only explicitly created approved rehearsal resources after evidence retention; this design created none.

## safe-validation-and-response.md
# Supply-chain policy assurance design — given evidence review only
Separate source review, dependency resolution, build identity/test status, content-addressed artifact/signature/provenance and target authorization. Every checkpoint binds to the actual artifact and reviewed source/configuration/target. A policy file's existence or a signed statement alone cannot prove end-to-end enforcement. A trusted signature from another builder or about another digest is not proof for this release.

Inventory all entrypoints including manual, rollback, emergency and alternate API/controller paths. The coverage CSV is an explicit pending assurance plan, not a report that those paths were checked. Require existing supported gates at the final effective-target boundary; if an entrypoint lacks enforcement, deny its use or request a scoped approved configuration change, not a business-code injection or default identity switch. Credentials/permission and source promotion ownership remain separated; do not add production credentials to untrusted PR jobs.

The supplied CSV describes intentionally invalid evidence cases at a conceptual level. Author/reviewer evaluate why each must be rejected; nobody creates forged proofs, replaces images, bypasses gates or executes offensive reproduction. Future safe validation may consume pre-existing authorized positive/negative fixtures in a private supported gate and retain actual status/reason plus no-target-change evidence. Missing authentic raw material means no native assurance claim; do not generate fake successful verification output.

For each denial record source/artifact/config/target identifiers, checkpoint, trusted evaluator/version, raw decision reference, operator/time and immutable audit link; omit secret values. A justified exception has one owner, exact scope, expiry, independent approval and compensating checks. Never turn an exception into global allow-all or silently skip unavailable verification. On detection stop release, quarantine only through an existing separately authorized scoped process, retain audit and restore a previously approved data-compatible pair if safe. Cleanup affects only own authorized test artifacts; no registry, cloud or deployment changes occur in this design.
